title: Goldman Sachs win Best Investment Bank USA 2012
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html: Despite significantly reduced revenues in 2011, the judging panel was overall highly supportive of Goldman’s recent investment banking activities and termed the Bank’s corporate social responsibility programmes as ‘inspirational’. The panel commented favourably on risk management at Goldman Sachs as well as referring to their ‘sterling work in M&A advisory and strong  revenue generation through equities trading.’
